specs.label: Engine oil
specs.value: 5W-30, or 0W-40 / 5W-40 with Porsche A40 approval. Confirm in manual.

specs.label: Oil capacity
specs.value: 6.9 L (7.3 qt) with filter. Start with 6 qt, then use the dipstick.

specs.label: Oil filter
specs.value: Cartridge, Mahle OX160D or equivalent, new O-ring

specs.label: Drain plug
specs.value: 19 mm, 22 ft-lb, new plug and crush washer

todo.title: First DIY oil change
todo.notes: Ramps, 36 mm filter socket, 19 mm socket, 8 qt oil, Mahle OX160D, new drain plug.

todo.title: Passenger headlight: water inside the lens
todo.notes: Moisture inside the passenger headlight housing. Check the housing seal and rear cap, dry it out and reseal. If it keeps coming back, the housing may need replacing.

todo.title: Interior dome and rear passenger overhead lights not working
todo.notes: Front dome lights and rear passenger overhead lights are both out. Check the interior lighting fuse first, then bulbs and door switches.

todo.title: Passenger front seat back panel coming off
todo.notes: Rear panel on the passenger seat back is separating. It's held on with double-sided adhesive strips. Fix: remove old adhesive, clean both surfaces with isopropyl alcohol, re-stick with automotive double-sided tape (e.g. 3M VHB or 3M auto attachment tape), press firmly and let it cure.
